summary.text: Clare Oumou Verbeten is a Democratic state senator who represents District 66 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Kathleen Bart.
She has worked for the City of St. Paul and as a political and labor organizer.

paragraphs.text: Oumou Verbeten was born in Minnesota and earned a bachelor's degree from American University in 2016. Her career experience includes working for the City of St. Paul.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as the daughter of a Senegalese immigrant and a second-generation Dutch American, a political and labor organizer, the Equity Manager at the City of St. Paul, and chair of the Roseville Area Schools Foundation.
Oumou Verbeten assumed office in the Minnesota State Senate on January 3, 2023, succeeding John Marty.
Her 2025-2026 committee assignments are Judiciary and Public Safety Finance and Policy, where she is vice chair, Education Finance, Higher Education Finance and Policy, and Labor and Industry Policy.
